title: NRI Property Management in Pondicherry & Kottakuppam
description: Living abroad? We find tenants, collect rent and look after your house or shop in Puducherry and Kottakuppam for 10% + GST. Book a free property check.
h1: Property Management for NRIs in Pondicherry and Kottakuppam
lead: Thousands of families from Pondicherry and Kottakuppam work in the Gulf, Singapore, Malaysia and France. Their houses and shops back home are looked after by whoever happens to be free — a cousin, a neighbour, an old tenant. It works until it doesn't.

blocks.p: We visit your property, film a full walk-through, check the rent against the market and send you a written report within three working days. You decide afterwards whether you want us to manage it.
blocks.note: Video calls at Gulf, Singapore, Malaysia or European hours — tell us your time.

items.q: How do I receive the rent?
items.a: Into your NRO account after the applicable TDS deduction, with a monthly statement. If a family member in India collects on your behalf, we can route it that way instead.

Rent paid to an NRI attracts TDS at the rates in force, deducted by the tenant and deposited against your PAN. We keep the paperwork organised for your CA — we are not tax advisors and would not pretend to be.

items.q: My house is locked and empty. Is it worth managing?
items.a: Often it is the case that needs it most. Empty houses deteriorate quietly and are the ones most at risk of unauthorised occupation. Our care plan covers regular visits, cleaning, minor repairs and bill payments.

items.q: Can you find a tenant if the property is vacant?
items.a: Yes. We advertise it, screen applicants, verify their identity and employment, and draft the agreement. The placement fee is one month's rent for leases under three years.

items.q: What if I want to sell instead?
items.a: We will value it honestly and handle the sale — visits, buyers, negotiation and registration — while you join by video call.
We cover Pondicherry, Kottakuppam and the areas nearby, including Auroville, Villianur, Ariyankuppam and Lawspet. Anything further we will tell you honestly if we can serve it well.
